MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 33

2. Solve for x: x + 4 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 4
   C. 11
   D. 8

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

4. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 28
   D. 29

5. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 1
   C. 21
   D. 20

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 13
   C. 17
   D. 15

7. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 64
   C. 0
   D. 65

8. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 2

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 24

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 25

11. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

12. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

13. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 81

14. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 82

15. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 11
   D. 122

16. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
